name: Render's Valley
summary: Blackrock orcs hold a camp in southeastern Redridge at Render's Valley. Their raids threaten travelers, and captives from nearby lands remain under guard.

sections.title: A Foothold in the Southeast
sections.body:
Among rocky ridges southeast of Lake Everstill, Blackrock orcs keep an auxiliary camp for their work in Redridge. War tents, banners, and sentry posts mark the valley, unlike the keeps and stone towers on the northern cliffs.

Fewer warriors serve here, and they carry less armor than the clan's main forces. Still, they raid local roads and harass travelers. Captured prisoners wait in crude cages under guard.

sections.title: Secret Paths and Captives
sections.body:
Scouts who reach Render's Valley find more than war parties on its dirt paths. Human prisoners are held in the camp, including a servant from the Tower of Azora in Elwynn Forest. He traded specialist goods beneath his captors' noses.

Unmarked paths cross the high southern bluffs behind the valley. Daring travelers can follow them into the murky bogs of the Swamp of Sorrows.

aliases: what clan is in renders valley
faq.answer: The aggressive Blackrock clan occupies Render's Valley. Its orcs have pushed south from the Burning Steppes into Redridge to conquer territory and harass human settlements.

faq.q: Are the orcs here as dangerous as the ones at Stonewatch?
aliases: how strong are the orcs here
faq.answer: No. The Blackrock warriors in Render's Valley are generally younger or less formidable skirmishers than the hardened elite forces at Stonewatch Keep to the north.

faq.q: Who is the prisoner kept in the camp?
faq.answer: A servant affiliated with the Tower of Azora in Elwynn Forest is held in a cage after the Blackrock clan captured him. Those who reach him can acquire specialized tailoring supplies.

faq.q: Can you reach the Swamp of Sorrows from here?
faq.answer: Yes. An unofficial mountain trail crosses the southern bluffs just past Render's Valley and leads into the northern marches of the Swamp of Sorrows.

angles.text: Render's Valley is a Blackrock raiding outpost that threatens southern Redridge. Clearing it helps secure trade and travel in Lakeshire.
The Captured Servant of Azora offers unique tailoring patterns and materials. Craftsmen must fight through the sentries to reach him.
